thread:
Carla: Heads-up — planning a staggered traffic shift for frontend-service -> v3 tonight 22:00 UTC. Starting eu-west, then us-west. Quiet window, deploy-bot will run a canary. Planned steps: 0 -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over ~35m. Need router weight ramp + drain adjustments.
Brian: Timeline? roll/rollback criteria?
Carla: Window 22:00–22:40. Step every 5m until 50%, then 25%->100%. Rollback if p95 > 250ms OR error rate > 1% sustained across two 5m checks.
Dmitri: Recommend router drain_secs=45 and health_probe=60s. Also set fallback route pinned to v2 for 10m after a fail.
Alice: I'll watch SLOs and post at each step. I'll alert if p95>250ms or 4xx/5xx trend up. @oncall please standby. :eyes: 
deploy-bot: To start the canary run this:
```
/deploy frontend-service --version v3 --strategy staggered --steps 10,25,50,100 --interval 300s --health 'p95<250ms,error<1%' --fallback v2 --drain 45s
```
React with :rocket: to approve kickoff. Logs will stream here.
Brian: +1 :thumbsup:
Dmitri: pushed lb change to staging: `lb-config.weight_rollout: staged=true`, `conn_draining:45`, `health_probe:60s`. Will push to router at T-5.
Carla: pushing to prod router at 21:55 for config apply. Reminder: keep temporary route pins until 23:10.
Alice: I'll post metric snapshots at 22:05, 22:10, 22:15 ... to #incidents and tag this thread.
deploy-bot: Kicking off canary now (22:00:00). step=10% -> target routing applied. Streaming logs: request rate nominal. health checks passing.
Brian: seeing a small 4xx blip at 22:05 (client error spike), investigating but not service impacting. Holding at 25% for one extra interval.
Dmitri: adjusted health_probe timeout +10s for backend pool B (was borderline), keeping drain at 45s.
Carla: holding at 25% for 10 more minutes as discussed. Monitoring.
Alice: p95 steady 180ms, errors at 0.6% during hold. No alerts.
deploy-bot: resuming rollout -> 50% at 22:20. step complete.
Carla: 50% stable for 15m, no regressions :thumbsup:. Proceeding to final 100% at 22:30.
Brian: small transient increase in 5xx at 22:22, cleared after pool B adjustment by Dmitri. No rollback.
deploy-bot: final step applied — 100% traffic to v3 at 22:35. health: OK.
Dmitri: reverted temporary routing flags, confirmed normal weights on router.
Carla: Release notes updated: https://internal/docs/releases/frontend-service-v3 (added rollout timeline and rollback criteria).
Alice: I'll keep a watch for the next 30m and then close the incident feed.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished SUCCESS at 22:40:12. Artifacts: build-2026-03-21-457.
Carla: Thanks team — closing thread. If anyone sees anything after 23:10 ping this thread or @oncall. :white_check_mark:
